t: Step-by-Step Guide to Facebook Integration in Eleva
html:
Facebook Integration in Eleva allows you to directly sync lead data from Facebook Lead Ads into your CRM. Once connected, new leads can automatically trigger workflows, populate pipelines, and initiate nurture campaigns without manual imports.

TABLE OF CONTENTS

  • Overview of Facebook Integration
  • Key Benefits of Facebook Integration
  • How to Connect Facebook to a Sub-account
  • Connect Multiple Facebook Accounts Through Marketplace
  • Frequently Asked Questions
  • Related Articles
Overview of Facebook Integration

Facebook integration allows you to connect your Facebook Business Page and sync leads directly into a Eleva sub-account. This connection supports Lead Ads created via Facebook’s Instant Forms and enables powerful automation using Eleva Workflows. Once connected, you can also enable access to your Instagram Business account if it's linked to your Facebook page.

Key Benefits of Facebook Integration

Facebook integration allows Eleva users to automate lead capture from Facebook.

  • Lead Automation: Automatically syncs new Facebook leads to your CRM

  • Form Field Mapping: Aligns Facebook form responses with CRM fields

  • Sync Options: Choose to pull in past leads or only new ones going forward

  • Trigger Workflows: Use lead form submissions to launch automated sequences

How to Connect Facebook to a Sub-account

Step 1: Go to Sub-Account Settings

Navigate to Settings in the bottom-left corner of the screen

Step 2: Open Integrations

In the left-hand navigation within Settings, scroll down and click Integrations

Step 3: Click the Facebook–Instagram Card

Find the Facebook–Instagram card in the top-right section of the Integrations screen and click Connect

Step 4: Complete Facebook Login and Permissions

A pop-up window will ask you to log into your Facebook account. Make sure to:

  • Log into the correct Facebook account

  • Approve all required permissions (especially access to leads and page data)

  • Select the correct Facebook Page to sync

Note: You must have Admin access to both the Facebook Page and the Business Manager it’s connected to.

Step 5: Choose Page and Sync Options

After login, select:

  • The Facebook Page you want to integrate

  • Sync preference:

    • All Leads: Pull in historical leads and all new leads going forward

    • New Leads Only: Only sync leads submitted after this integration

Tip: You can search Facebook Pages (and Ad Accounts, when available) by name to find the right selection faster. Search appears after your pages finish loading because Meta does not provide native search for this step. Accounts with many pages may take longer to load before search is available.

Step 6: Confirm Integration

  • Click Connect and Continue to finalize the integration. You’ll see a green banner in the upper-right that says Integration successful

Step 7: Map Facebook Form Fields to CRM Fields

Map your Facebook form fields to the appropriate CRM fields inside Eleva. This ensures every lead’s data, like email, phone, and name, lands in the right place.

Connect Multiple Facebook Accounts Through Marketplace

Eleva now supports multiple Facebook accounts within a single sub-account. You can connect multiple Pages under each account and use them for lead syncing, messaging, and automations.

Step 1: Enable the Feature

  1. Go to Labs. Enable Facebook marketplace migration & multiple account support.
  2. Navigate to Settings → Integrations / Marketplace. Open the Facebook integration.

Step 2: Connect Facebook Accounts

  1. Open the External Connection tab.
  2. Click Add Account.
  3. Sign in to Facebook and grant the required permissions.
  4. Select the Facebook Pages you want to connect.
  5. Repeat to connect additional Facebook accounts.

Step 3: Manage Facebook Pages

  1. Open Manage Facebook Account.
  2. Select a Facebook account from the dropdown.
  3. Open Manage pages.
  4. Select the required Pages and click Save.

Step 4: Manage Messaging

  1. Open the Messaging tab.
  2. Review the connected Facebook Pages.
  3. Use the Facebook and Instagram toggles to enable or disable messaging.

Note: Instagram messaging requires a linked Instagram account.

Step 5: Manage Lead Forms

  1. Open Manage forms.
  2. Select the required Facebook Page.
  3. Review the lead forms, mapping, and sync status.
  4. Click Refresh forms to refresh the form list when needed.

Important Notes

  • Multiple Facebook accounts support Lead Sync, Messaging, and Automation.
  • Shops and Ad Accounts currently support only one Facebook account.
  • Facebook assets depend on the permissions granted during authorization.
  • Existing Facebook connections are being migrated to Marketplace.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What permissions are required to connect a Facebook page?
You must be an Admin of the Facebook Page and the associated Business Manager. If you see “page not visible,” check these permissions and try again.

Q: Can I connect more than one Facebook page?
Yes. You can connect multiple pages to a sub-account. For more information, see Connect Multiple Facebook Pages to Eleva Sub-account.

Q: What happens if my token expires?
You will see a reconnection prompt. To fix this, follow the steps in A Facebook Token Has Expired In Your Eleva Account.

Q: Can I trigger a workflow when a Facebook form is submitted?
Absolutely! Use the Facebook Lead Form Submitted workflow trigger to launch automations when new leads come in.

Q: How do I test if the integration is working?
You can use Facebook’s Lead Ads Testing Tool or submit a test form manually to verify that the lead appears in your CRM.

Q: Does this also integrate Instagram leads?
Yes, if your Instagram Business account is connected to your Facebook Page. For setup instructions, see How to connect your Instagram business account.
